newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DUFERCO SAYS INTERESTED IN STEELMAKER CLABECQ.
newsitem.headline: DUFERCO SAYS INTERESTED IN STEELMAKER CLABECQ.

text.p: Private steel and commodities trader Duferco said on Friday it was interested in taking over the operations of bankrupt Belgian steelmaker Forges de Clabecq.
The firm said in a statement it was carrying out a feasibility study into the possibility of taking over all of the activities of Clabecq, which was declared bankrupt in January.
Earlier this week businessman Roberto Grosso visited the plant. But it was not clear who he was representing.
Duferco said in its statement that Grosso was acting as its representative in Belgium.
The firm said its representatives had on Friday met the receivers who have been trying to find a buyer for the firm since it was declared bankrupt.
It added that more contacts were due in coming weeks.
